text: The main advantage is flexibility: you can study at your own pace and from anywhere, which suits people with jobs or family commitments. It's also often cheaper, since you save on transport and accommodation. The downside is that it requires a lot of self-discipline, and you miss out on the spontaneous discussions that happen in a classroom. So I'd say it works best for motivated, independent learners.

tips.en: Precise topic vocabulary lifts the Lexical Resource score.
tips.kk: Тақырыпқа сай нақты лексика Lexical Resource бағасын көтереді.
tips.ru: Точная лексика по теме повышает оценку Lexical Resource.
tips.example: you can study at your own pace and from anywhere

tips.en: 'The downside is that' moves clearly to the drawbacks.
tips.kk: «The downside is that» кемшіліктерге анық өтеді.
tips.ru: «The downside is that» чётко переходит к минусам.

note.en: as fast or slow as you want

questions.question: What are the advantages of studying online compared with studying in a classroom?

text: For routine updates, absolutely, because they save time and travel costs. But I don't think they can fully replace in-person meetings, particularly when building trust or discussing sensitive issues. Much of communication is non-verbal, like body language and tone, and that gets lost on a screen. Also, there's the so-called Zoom fatigue, where long calls become surprisingly draining.

tips.en: Partial agreement plus a qualification shows a mature stance.
tips.kk: Ішінара келісім мен ескерту жетілген ұстанымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Частичное согласие и оговорка показывают зрелую позицию.
tips.example: But I don't think they can fully replace in-person meetings

tips.en: A modern term shows familiarity with the topic.
tips.ru: Современный термин показывает знакомство с темой.

questions.question: Do you think video calls can replace face-to-face meetings?

text: It can be, especially if you share a specific interest, like gaming or photography, because you immediately have something to talk about. I've seen some online friendships become deeper than offline ones. That said, it takes time to build genuine trust, and there's a risk that people aren't who they claim to be. So I'd suggest meeting in person eventually, if possible.

tips.en: 'It can be, especially if' gives a conditional answer without being absolute.
tips.kk: «It can be, especially if» қатаң емес шартты жауап береді.
tips.ru: «It can be, especially if» даёт условный ответ без категоричности.
tips.example: It can be, especially if you share a specific interest

tips.en: 'That said' adds a risk after a benefit.
tips.example: That said, it takes time to build genuine trust

note.en: the identity they say they have

questions.question: Is it easy to make real friends online?

text: I think it could be transformative. Imagine history students walking through ancient Rome, or medical students practising surgery without risk. VR makes abstract ideas tangible, which can boost both understanding and memory. The obstacle is cost, since the equipment is still expensive for many schools. If prices come down, I could see it becoming a regular part of lessons within a decade or so.

tips.en: Vivid scenarios with 'Imagine' make the idea tangible.
tips.kk: «Imagine» арқылы берілген жандуы жағдайлар идеяны көрнекі етеді.
tips.ru: Живые сценарии с «Imagine» делают идею наглядной.
tips.example: Imagine history students walking through ancient Rome

tips.en: A conditional with 'could see' sounds flexible and natural.
tips.kk: «could see» бар шартты сөйлем икемді әрі табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Условное предложение с «could see» звучит гибко и естественно.
tips.example: If prices come down, I could see it becoming a regular part of lessons within a decade or so
